description: Geoid undulation N above the WGS84 ellipsoid; convert FABDEM orthometric height H to WGS84 ellipsoidal height h with h = H + N.

source.license: MIT (GeographicLib distribution; derived from NGA EGM2008 data)

grid.layout: row-major; north-to-south rows; eastward columns; longitude range [0, 360)
grid.sampleEncoding: JSON number, metres, quantized to 0.003 m
